# Novus Freight

> Novus Freight moves cargo by sea, air and land, clears it through the Bureau of Customs and delivers it to your door, across the Philippines and abroad.

Note: this file is a demo built from sample data. Details will be replaced once Novus Freight confirms them.

Freight forwarder and customs broker based in Manila, Philippines. Answers questions in English and Filipino (Tagalog, Taglish).

## Services
- [Sea freight · FCL](https://garciaralphlawrence-svg.github.io/LogiSys-Demo/novus/#svc-sea-fcl): Full container loads (20ft, 40ft, 40ft high cube and reefer) for import and export, door to door or port to port.
- [Sea freight · LCL consolidation](https://garciaralphlawrence-svg.github.io/LogiSys-Demo/novus/#svc-sea-lcl): Pay only for the space you use. Your cargo shares a container with other shippers, priced per cubic meter (CBM).
- [Air freight](https://garciaralphlawrence-svg.github.io/LogiSys-Demo/novus/#svc-air): Fast import and export by air through NAIA and Clark, priced per chargeable kilogram.
- [Customs brokerage (BOC e2m)](https://garciaralphlawrence-svg.github.io/LogiSys-Demo/novus/#svc-customs): Licensed customs brokers prepare and lodge your import or export entry in BOC e2m, compute duties and taxes and follow it through to release.
- [Trucking and delivery](https://garciaralphlawrence-svg.github.io/LogiSys-Demo/novus/#svc-trucking): Container haulage and closed-van trucking from the port or airport to your warehouse, across Luzon and in Cebu and Davao.
- [Warehousing](https://garciaralphlawrence-svg.github.io/LogiSys-Demo/novus/#svc-warehousing): Short and long-term storage near the Manila ports, with pallet in and out and inventory reports.
- [Door-to-door](https://garciaralphlawrence-svg.github.io/LogiSys-Demo/novus/#svc-door-to-door): One quote, one contact: pickup from your supplier abroad, freight, customs clearance and delivery to your door.
- [Project and heavy cargo](https://garciaralphlawrence-svg.github.io/LogiSys-Demo/novus/#svc-project-cargo): Machinery, oversized and heavy-lift cargo, planned end to end, from flat racks and break-bulk to site delivery.
- [PEZA and ecozone shipments](https://garciaralphlawrence-svg.github.io/LogiSys-Demo/novus/#svc-peza): Shipments for PEZA and Freeport locators, with the boat note, transfer and ecozone permits handled together with customs.
- [Import and export permits](https://garciaralphlawrence-svg.github.io/LogiSys-Demo/novus/#svc-permits): We help secure the permits regulated goods need before they ship: FDA, BPI, BFAR, NTC, DTI PS/ICC and similar.

## Not offered
- Novus handles cargo, not passenger travel, so we can’t book plane tickets, tours or visas.
- Novus moves cargo, not money, so we don’t offer remittance or money transfer.

## Ports and coverage
- Manila International Container Port (MICP) (Sea): Main container port for FCL and LCL imports and exports.
- Port of Manila · South Harbor (Sea): Container and break-bulk cargo, including project cargo.
- NAIA (Manila airport cargo) (Air): Air import and export.
- Port of Cebu (Sea and air): Domestic LCL and FCL from Manila, plus international via Cebu.
- Port of Davao (Sasa) (Sea): Domestic LCL and FCL from Manila, plus international via Davao.
- Subic Bay Freeport (Sea): Freeport and container cargo for Central and North Luzon.
- Clark (Freeport and airport) (Air): Air cargo and Freeport locators.
- Other Philippine ports are handled through partner haulers on request.

## Documents
- Sea shipment documents: Commercial invoice; Packing list; Bill of lading (B/L); Import permit, if the goods are regulated; Certificate of origin (for lower duties under trade agreements)
- Air shipment documents: Commercial invoice; Packing list; Air waybill (AWB); Import permit, if the goods are regulated; MSDS for chemicals or batteries
- Customs clearance (BOC) documents: Commercial invoice; Packing list; Bill of lading or air waybill; Importer accreditation (BOC Client Profile Registration); TIN of the importer; Permits for regulated goods (FDA, BPI, NTC, etc.); Certificate of origin, if claiming lower duties
- PEZA / ecozone shipment documents: Commercial invoice; Packing list; Bill of lading or air waybill; PEZA permit / boat note; Locator certificate of registration; Transfer documents for bonded trucking
- Typical permit requirements: Product details and photos; Company registration (SEC or DTI); Supplier details and invoice; Agency-specific forms (FDA, BPI, BFAR, NTC, DTI); Laboratory or test reports, if required

## FAQ
- Q: Do you handle small shipments?
  A: Yes. Use sea LCL from 1 CBM, or air freight from 45 kg. Many of our clients are SMEs and online sellers importing for the first time.
- Q: I’m importing for the first time. Where do I start?
  A: Send us your supplier’s invoice and packing list. We check if your goods need a permit, register you as an importer with BOC if needed, and give you an all-in quote before anything ships.
- Q: Can you compute my duties and taxes?
  A: Yes. Our brokers compute duties, VAT and other taxes from your invoice and the tariff code before you pay, so there are no surprises at release.
- Q: How long does customs clearance take?
  A: Most complete, green-lane entries clear in 2 to 4 working days after the vessel arrives. Yellow or red lane, missing permits or holds take longer, and we tell you the moment that happens.
- Q: What does “assessment” or “lane” mean in customs?
  A: After your entry is lodged, BOC assesses it and assigns a lane. Green lane means no inspection, so it moves straight to duty payment and release. Yellow means a document check; red means a physical exam of the cargo. Novus follows up at every step.
- Q: How do I pay?
  A: We bill per shipment by bank transfer. Credit terms are available for regular accounts after review.
- Q: Can my cargo be insured?
  A: Yes. We can arrange cargo insurance on request. Ask for it when you request your quote.
- Q: Do you ship dangerous goods?
  A: Yes, on request, with the proper safety data sheet (MSDS), packing and declaration. Some classes need carrier approval first, so tell us early.
- Q: How do I track my shipment?
  A: Type your Novus tracking number (it starts with NVF-) on the Track page or right here in the chat. You’ll see every step, including the BOC customs steps.
- Q: How fast can I get a quote?
  A: You get a ballpark right away on our quote page. A confirmed written quote usually follows within one working day.
